name: 布兰
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:510
who: Bran, a halfling carter of forty from the mead hills, small, about 106 cm, round and stout, with the soft round face of his people and a permanent smile. Pale gold curls poking out from under a soft cap, light spring-green eyes that squint into two slits when he laughs, a nose reddened by mead, chubby hands with short fingers that twirl a charcoal stick. A cheerful, shrewd, easygoing air.
palette: pale gold and spring green, worn wool brown, mead-amber, charcoal grey
casual: His carter's clothes: an old wool coat patched at the elbows, a soft cap, brown trousers and sturdy shoes; a cheese knife at the belt, a thick ledger book tucked under one arm, a charcoal stick between his fingers. A cheerful smile.
private: Easy day: the coat off, a long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, braces over it, soft shoes, the cap pushed back; a small clay cup in one hand. A sleepy happy smile.
battle: Ready to hold the line: the patched coat buttoned, a leather cap tied on, thick leather gloves; he holds the cheese knife out nervously in front in his right hand and hugs the ledger to his chest with the left. A worried but stubborn look.
battle_pose: 3) the stand-your-ground outfit: feet planted a little wider, the shoulders squared, the cheese knife held out in front in one hand and the ledger hugged to the chest with the other; a worried, stubborn look, he is not smiling in this one.
formal: At a market day: his best brown wool coat brushed, a clean white collar, a feather in the soft cap, the ledger held open in both hands. A proud businesslike smile.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted, light green eyes crinkled in a smile, the pale gold curls under the soft cap. Warm lantern light from one side, cool evening light from the other. Foreground blur: a charcoal stick and a drifting page corner.

name: 卡特琳
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:566
who: Katrin, a human gate guard of thirty at the west gate of Wheat-Bridge city: tall, about 172 cm, lean and strong. Glossy black hair with a blue sheen cut to the chin, her left eyebrow cut through by an old blade (on the viewer's right when they face us), deep ink-blue eyes that do not blink, a thin face with high cheekbones and a mouth pressed into a line like a door seam. A stern, orderly, unyielding air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, stern young woman's face with high cheekbones, ink-blue steady eyes, a pressed closed mouth, and the left eyebrow cut by a thin pale scar (on the viewer's right when they face us).
build: 172 cm, tall, long-legged and sturdy: strong shoulders, a C-cup, a trim waist and firm hips.
palette: ink blue and glossy black, wheat straw, aged leather brown, bronze
casual: Her guard's uniform: the Wheat-Bridge guard's leather armor with the town crest branded on the chest, a bridge wound with wheat stalks, over a wool tunic and dark trousers with tall boots; a long spear with a straw-colored tassel in her right hand; a bronze seal hanging at her belt. She stands rigidly straight.
private: Off duty: a plain long-sleeved dark wool tunic to mid-thigh and brown trousers, soft boots, the bronze seal still on her belt, hair neat. Arms folded, a stern calm look.
battle: On guard: the branded leather armor with leather bracers and greaves, a round shield on the left arm, an iron cap; the long straw-tasselled spear held level at the ready in both hands. An unblinking glare.
formal: At a gate ceremony: the leather armor oiled, a clean white town surcoat with the wheat-and-bridge crest, a short dark cloak, the polished bronze seal at the chest; the spear upright at her side. Rigid, solemn.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face level, ink-blue eyes unblinking, the cut eyebrow clear, a line of a mouth. Hard side light from a gate arch, a warm wheat-colored glow from the other side. Foreground blur: a straw tassel and drifting dust.

name: 娜卡
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:630
who: Naka, a fox-eared runner of twenty from a fox clan, light and quick: about 160 cm, slim. A long red-fox ponytail that flies high when she runs, a pair of fox ears with a tuft of white at each tip (both ears whole at this point), amber eyes, one small cheeky fang showing when she grins, freckles across her nose. Restless, cheerful, fast.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lively young woman's face with amber eyes, a scatter of freckles across the nose, red-fox ears with white tips on top of the head (and NO human ears at the sides), a grin showing one small fang.
build: 160 cm, slim and light, long-legged: a B-cup, a narrow waist and small hips.
palette: fox red and white, amber, deerskin buff, worn wool brown
casual: Her runner's clothes: a short leather jacket with tiny cloth strips sewn along the cuffs, each from a household she has carried messages for, wraps round the calves, soft deerskin shoes; a deerskin letter pouch on her back. She stands with one foot forward as if about to run, a cheeky grin.
private: Easy day: the leather jacket off, a long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and brown trousers, soft shoes, the ponytail swinging; the letter pouch hanging at her side. A relaxed closed-mouth smile.
battle: Racing through danger: the jacket buckled, leather bracers, the letter pouch strapped tight across the chest, calf wraps tight; a short knife held low in her right hand. Leaning low, ears flat, a fierce look.
formal: At a clan gathering: a clean short jacket of dyed red wool with all the cuff strips lined up neatly, a white linen shirt, a clean sash, the pouch polished; hair tied with a ribbon. A bright proud smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, amber eyes bright, a fanged grin, the white-tipped ears forward. Warm low sun from one side, cool shadow from the other. Foreground blur: wind-blown grass and a flying cloth strip.

name: 塔赫
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:686
who: Tahe, a wolf-eared houndmaster of eighteen from the hunting grounds, lean and long-limbed: about 183 cm, slim with broad shoulders, a young man still growing into his height. Untidy grey-black hair, a pair of upright wolf ears silver-grey on the backs, ice-blue eyes that glance down first when meeting someone, an old dog-scratch scar down his right cheek (on the viewer's left when they face us), two long canine teeth showing when he grins. Shy, quiet, good with animals.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's lean face with ice-blue eyes, a thin pale scar down the right cheek (on the viewer's left when they face us), grey-black hair, upright silver-grey wolf ears on top of the head (and NO human ears at the sides), a shy closed mouth.
build: 183 cm, lean and long-limbed with broad shoulders.
palette: silver grey and ice blue, wolf-fur brown, bone white, worn leather
casual: His hunter's clothes: a wolf-eared hunter's fur vest over a plain wool shirt with rolled sleeves, hide trousers and soft boots; a coil of dog leashes at the belt and a bone whistle on a cord at the neck; a short bow slung over his back. He looks down shyly.
private: Easy day: the vest off, a loose long-sleeved wool shirt and trousers, soft boots, the whistle still at his neck. Hands in his pockets, a faint shy smile.
battle: On the hunt: the fur vest belted tight, leather bracers, a quiver at the hip; the short bow drawn halfway in both hands, the bone whistle held in his teeth, ears flat back. A sharp focused look.
formal: At a hunting-ground gathering: a clean grey wool tunic edged with a wolf-fur collar, closed with a bone toggle and a leather strap, a cast-bronze clan badge pinned at the shoulder, the bone whistle on a polished cord that shimmers faintly when held, the hair combed. He stands straight, a shy proud smile.
art: A portrait, the head tilted down then glancing up, ice-blue eyes cool, the scar clear, the ears upright. Pale cold dawn light from one side, a warm glow from the other. Foreground blur: a hound's nose and drifting frost.

name: 茵莉
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:806
who: Inri, a human highland hunter of nineteen from the village under the cliff: about 166 cm, lithe and sturdy. A long pale flax-colored braid whose end is tied with a storm-hawk feather that was her father's, grey-blue eyes narrowed when she looks far, cheeks reddened by the highland wind, thin lips with one corner that lifts first when she smiles. Quick, brave, wry.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lithe young woman's face with wind-reddened cheeks, narrowed grey-blue eyes, thin lips, a half-smile lifting on one side.
build: 166 cm, lithe and sturdy with strong legs: a B-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: flax and storm-hawk brown, grey-blue, cream down, worn leather
casual: Her hunter's clothes: a highland hunter's leather jacket with a collar ringed with storm-hawk down, a long wool shirt under it, brown trousers and laced boots; a short bow in her left hand (on the viewer's right), a quiver of hawk-fletched arrows at the hip. A wry half-smile.
private: Easy day: the jacket off, a long-sleeved wool dress to the shins in cream with a leather belt, thick wool stockings and soft boots, the braid over one shoulder. Hands behind her back, a relaxed smile.
battle: On a cliff-side hunt: the jacket belted tight, leather bracers and a glove on the draw hand, the hawk-down collar high; the short bow drawn to the cheek with a hawk-fletched arrow, the braid swinging. A narrowed, focused look.
formal: At the village festival: a clean sky-blue wool dress with long sleeves and a white collar under a short dyed jacket, the braid tied with the hawk feather and a ribbon, the bow left behind. A warm half-smile.
art: A portrait, the grey-blue eyes narrowed toward a far cliff, then toward the viewer, a half-smile. Cold bright wind light from one side, warm sun from the other. Foreground blur: a drifting hawk feather and cliff grass.

name: 托德
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:870
who: Todd, a halfling cook of a wagon train, forty and never older, small, about 104 cm, round and plump, with the soft round face of his people. Ginger hair clipped close to the scalp, tiny eyes that vanish into slits when he smiles, hands covered in knife nicks and grease. Warm, cheerful, always working, always checking whether anyone is hungry.
palette: ginger red, grease-glossy brown, iron grey, flour cream
casual: His cook's clothes: a greasy shiny apron over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, brown trousers and soft shoes; a vegetable knife at his belt; on his back an ordinary iron cooking pot with a polished rim and a small dent in the bottom as if bitten. A beaming smile with eyes shut.
private: Easy day: the apron off, a long-sleeved cream wool shirt and trousers, soft shoes, the iron pot slung on his back, a wooden ladle in one hand. A sleepy beaming smile.
battle: Ready to feed the line: the apron cinched, leather gloves, a thick wool cap; he holds the iron pot up in front of the chest like a shield in one hand and the knife in the other. A fierce, worried look.
battle_pose: 3) the pot-bearer outfit: braced and determined, the feet a little wider, the iron pot held up in front of the chest like a shield in one hand and the knife held low in the other; a fierce look, he is not smiling in this one.
formal: At a feast: a clean white apron over a brown waistcoat and white shirt, a small cook's cap, the iron pot polished on his back; a wooden ladle held up proudly. A big beaming smile.
art: A close portrait, the plump face glowing, eyes shut in a beaming smile. Warm cooking-fire orange from below, cool blue dusk from behind. Foreground blur: drifting steam and a spoon.

name: 萝丝
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:926
who: Rose, a halfling wagon-train leader of fifty from the mead hills, small, about 102 cm, sturdy and round, with the soft round face of her people lined by age. Grey-white curls tucked into a headscarf embroidered with bees, honey-colored eyes, deep laugh lines at the eyes but the corners of her mouth turned down, inky fingers. A brisk, shrewd, motherly air.
face_extra: Deep laugh lines at the eyes and gentle wrinkles at the mouth show her age, on the same round face.
palette: honey and grey-white, bee yellow, worn wool brown, ink black
casual: Her leader's clothes: a thick wool coat with shiny worn cuffs, the bee-embroidered headscarf, a long wool skirt and sturdy shoes; a ledger at her belt and a string of fourteen cart-bells, seven of them wrapped in cloth so they stay silent. A brisk, tight-lipped look.
private: Easy day: the coat off, a long-sleeved patched wool dress to the ankles with a shawl, the headscarf still on, soft shoes, the bells unhooked. A tired kind smile.
battle: Ready to lead the wagons out: the coat buttoned to the chin, a leather cap over the scarf, thick gloves; she clutches the ledger to her chest with one hand and holds the string of bells up in the other. A stern, determined look.
battle_pose: 3) the wagon-leader outfit: squared and braced, the feet planted wider, the ledger clutched to the chest in one hand and the bell string held up in the other; a stern look, she is not smiling in this one.
formal: At a caravan fair: her best honey-colored wool dress under a clean dark coat, a freshly embroidered bee headscarf, a brooch at the collar, the ledger held in both hands. A proud, polite smile.
art: A close portrait, honey eyes looking straight at the viewer, the mouth set but the eyes soft. Warm lantern light from one side, cool dusk from the other. Foreground blur: a hanging cloth-wrapped bell and a page corner.

name: 栗林城伯爵
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:1133
who: The Count of Chestnut Wood, a human sun-kingdom noble in his sixties, thin and stiff: about 176 cm. White hair, hazel eyes, a gaunt face, a gilded circlet with three empty jewel settings where the rubies were sold for grain. A grieving, proud, closed-up air; he lost his son at the river bank. The gilded circlet holds NO gemstones at all: its three settings are bare, empty gold claws with nothing inside them, no ruby, no red stone, only the metal showing where the stones once sat; draw it gemless in every panel, the head and the expression sheet.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt old nobleman's face of about sixty-five, hazel eyes, thin white eyebrows, a tight closed mouth.
face_extra: Deep lines at the brow and mouth show his age.
palette: deep ruby red and tarnished gold, white hair, hazel, black mourning band
casual: His court dress: a worn deep ruby-red wool robe with a faded gold-thread collar, a gilded circlet with three empty gem settings, a black mourning band on the left sleeve (on the viewer's right when they face us), dark trousers and boots. He stands stiffly with his hands clasped.
private: Off duty: a plain long grey wool house-robe to the ankle over a white shirt, soft shoes, no circlet. Hands folded, a weary look.
battle: Holding the gate: a dull steel breastplate stamped with the sun-kingdom crown over the worn ruby wool, a plain helm under his arm, the gold crown of rubies and pale star-stones on his head with three settings gaping empty where gems were pawned for grain, the remaining stones glowing dull red, a long sword on the belt (on the viewer's left) with his hand on the hilt. A cold, grieving glare.
formal: Meeting the other count: the worn ruby-red wool robe brushed, its faded gold-thread collar open at the neck, a fur-trimmed dark cloak, the gold crown of rubies and pale star-stones that hold a dim inner light, three settings left empty where gems were pawned for grain, a gold chain; he stands rigid, hands folded.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the hazel eyes hard and grieving, the three empty settings on the circlet clear. Cold grey light from one side, a dim warm gleam from the other. Foreground blur: a drifting grey cloth edge and a speck of ember. The circlet is gemless, three empty claw settings with nothing red in them.

name: 麦桥城伯爵
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:1133
who: The Count of Wheat-Bridge, a human sun-kingdom noble in his fifties, stout and heavy: about 175 cm. Thinning ginger-brown hair, a ruddy round face, warm brown eyes, a gold circlet set with one pale blue-white star-stone that he would not sell even while people starved. A stubborn, fond-of-comfort air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy ruddy man's face of about fifty-five, warm brown eyes, thick brows, a double chin, a closed pursed mouth.
build: 175 cm, stout and heavy-set with a round belly.
palette: star-stone blue-white and silver, ginger brown, rich navy, gold
casual: His court dress: a rich navy wool robe worked with blue-white silver thread, a gold circlet with one pale star-stone set in front, a gold chain, fine boots. He stands with his thumbs in his belt.
private: Off duty: a loose long wool house-robe in dark blue over a white shirt, soft slippers, no circlet. Hands clasped over his belly.
battle: At the gate: a polished steel breastplate stamped with the wheat-and-bridge crest over the navy robe, a heavy cloak, the heavy gold crown of rubies and pale star-stones on his head, a sword on the belt (on the viewer's left) with his hand on the hilt; the one blue-white star-stone at the brow glowing steady. A stubborn look.
formal: Meeting the other count: the navy robe worked with blue-white silver thread, a long dark cloak lined with white fur, a heavy gold crown crowded with rubies and pale star-stones that shine softly, a gold chain, and at the brow the one great blue-white star-stone he would not sell. He stands pompous and still.
art: A portrait, the face large, brown eyes wary and the pale star-stone glinting at the brow. Warm candle gleam from one side, cool grey light from the other. Foreground blur: a blurred gold chain link and a speck of light.

name: 狼耳首领
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:1147
who: The wolf-eared chieftain of the north hunting ground, a man in his fifties, tall and spare: about 190 cm. Grey-white wolf ears, the left-hand one (on the viewer's left when they face us) notched at the tip from a bear long ago, grey-white hair, amber eyes, a weathered scarred face. His words sound like orders. Stern, patient, waiting.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about fifty-five, amber eyes, deep lines, a thin closed mouth, grey-white wolf ears on top of the head (and NO human ears at the sides), the ear tip on the viewer's left notched.
face_extra: Deep weathered lines at the eyes and mouth show his age.
palette: grey-white and amber, wolf-fur brown, bone, dark leather
casual: His chieftain's clothes: a heavy wolf-fur cloak over a leather jerkin and wool shirt, hide leggings and tall boots, a bone clasp at the throat; a long hunting bow in his left hand (on the viewer's right). He stands very still.
private: Off duty: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved wool shirt and leather vest, hide trousers, soft boots. Arms at his sides, a tired calm look.
battle: Facing the other camp: the fur cloak thrown back, leather bracers, a quiver at the hip; the long bow held low in the left hand with an arrow, the bow not raised. A patient, hard look.
formal: At the first gathering of the clans: a clean grey wool tunic edged in wolf fur, a bone-clasp cloak, polished boots, the bow left behind. He stands tall and solemn.
art: A portrait, amber eyes steady, the notched ear tip clear, a thin line of a mouth. Cold pale dawn from one side, warm low sun from the other. Foreground blur: tall dry grass and a drifting fur strand.

name: 鹿耳首领
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_三_午祷下.md:1147
who: The deer-eared chieftain of the south hunting ground, a man in his forties, thin and quiet: about 178 cm. A pair of slender long deer ears, warm chestnut hair, soft hazel eyes, a short antler tine pinned at the left temple (on the viewer's right when they face us), once his father's. His words sound like old sayings passed down. Gentle, patient, waiting. He is in his mid-forties and must read as a mature man, not a youth: fine lines at the corners of the eyes and from the nose to the mouth, slightly hollowed cheeks, a calm settled face, in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin gentle man's face of about forty-five, soft hazel eyes, a closed mouth, slender long deer ears on top of the head (and NO human ears at the sides), a short antler tine pinned at the left temple (on the viewer's right when they face us). Fine lines at the corners of the eyes and from the nose to the mouth; a mature man of about forty-five, not a young man.
palette: chestnut and fawn, antler cream, soft green, salt white
casual: His chieftain's clothes: a layered fawn-hide cloak over a green wool tunic, hide trousers and soft boots, a bead string at the throat; in his right hand a pinch of coarse salt held in an open palm. He stands quietly.
private: Off duty: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved green wool tunic, hide trousers, soft boots. Hands open at his sides, a gentle look.
battle: Holding the migration route: the fawn cloak belted, leather bracers, a short bow held low in the left hand (on the viewer's right), a quiver at the hip. A resolute, gentle look.
formal: At the first gathering of the clans: a clean fawn tunic embroidered with a green antler pattern, a bead-and-bone necklace, a cloak with a bone clasp. He stands solemn and still.
art: A portrait, soft hazel eyes level, the antler tine at the temple clear, the open palm with a pinch of salt held toward the viewer at the lower edge. Soft green morning light from one side, warm gold from the other. Foreground blur: drifting grass seeds and a few salt grains.
